prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1258; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not say my name on the recording, if that's all right. I can give you the details of the accident.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in Katy, Texas. I was turning left from a main road onto a side street, and the light had just turned yellow when I started through.

Q: What happened next?

A: A vehicle coming from the opposite direction hit the front driver's side of my car. I didn't see it coming in time. The impact spun my car partway around.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbags didn't deploy, but the belt caught me hard across the chest and shoulder.

Q: Did you feel any injuries right away?

A: Not at first. I was sore that evening, mostly in my neck and lower back. By the next morning, I could barely turn my head to check my mirror.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next day. They diagnosed a neck strain and a lower back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. Sitting for long periods makes my back worse, and I still have stiffness in my neck, especially in the mornings. I've missed some work because of it.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I appreciate you taking the time to hear my account.
